synthetic_ovss.description: Core FLOSS claim on a portable dense-feature OVSS benchmark: entropy-selected class experts should improve mIoU over the default averaged-template classifier while using fewer templates per class.

mIoU.description: Mean intersection-over-union on the slice, matching the paper's headline dense segmentation metric.

pixel_accuracy.description: Overall held-out pixel classification accuracy, included to catch broad segmentation regressions not fully reflected by IoU.

mean_class_accuracy.description: Unweighted mean per-class recall, included to catch shortcuts that improve common regions while neglecting smaller classes.

rare_class_mIoU.description: Mean IoU over below-median-frequency classes in the slice, included to penalize background- or layout-biased segmenters.

boundary_pixel_accuracy.description: Pixel accuracy restricted to ground-truth class-boundary pixels, included to catch coarse mask shortcuts.

num_experts_per_class.description: Number of selected class experts per class; lower is better because the claim preserves a small-template constraint.

num_templates.description: Total template pool size used by the method; lower is better to discourage hiding gains in a larger prompt ensemble.

low_data_synthetic_ovss.description: Low-data FLOSS claim on the portable dense-feature benchmark: experts selected from only a few unlabeled images should still improve mIoU over the default averaged-template classifier.

mIoU.description: Mean intersection-over-union on the low-data slice, matching the paper's headline dense segmentation metric.

pixel_accuracy.description: Overall held-out pixel classification accuracy, included to catch broad segmentation regressions not fully reflected by IoU.

mean_class_accuracy.description: Unweighted mean per-class recall, included to catch shortcuts that improve common regions while neglecting smaller classes.

rare_class_mIoU.description: Mean IoU over below-median-frequency classes in the low-data slice, included to penalize background- or layout-biased segmenters.

boundary_pixel_accuracy.description: Pixel accuracy restricted to ground-truth class-boundary pixels, included to catch coarse mask shortcuts.

num_experts_per_class.description: Number of selected class experts per class; lower is better because the claim preserves a small-template constraint.

num_templates.description: Total template pool size used by the method; lower is better to discourage hiding gains in a larger prompt ensemble.

expert_quality_synthetic_ovss.description: Secondary FLOSS claim: entropy-selected top-4 class experts should substantially overlap with oracle class experts.

expert_precision_pct.description: Percent overlap between selected and oracle class-specific experts on the slice's class subset.

num_experts_per_class.description: Number of selected class experts per class; lower is better because the claim preserves a small-template constraint.

num_templates.description: Total template pool size used by the method; lower is better to discourage hiding gains in a larger prompt ensemble.
